text:
Pranav: FYI compliance ping — they want an auditable export that shows quota + routing policy changes along with the 'why' (justification) and who approved it. Can we sketch what to persist and what to export?
Maria: We currently stash a free_text justification on change_event.metadata.justification. Not structured. Auditors want searchable fields: reason, ticket, approver, timestamp.
Oliver: Structured fields + optional free_text makes sense. Also add a redaction flag per field for PII. But this is a schema change to the change_event payloads.
Sara: For exports they asked for tamper-proofing. Suggest signed NDJSON/CSV with an HMAC header and per-line signature. Also pre-change + post-change snapshots for context.
audit-bot: Logged compliance request REQ-4527 — export format and retention clarified needed.
Kevin: Performance note: if we embed whole policy blobs for every change we'll blow up export sizes. Prefer diffs + a link to the config artifact stored in object storage. For downloads, stream and paginate.
Pranav: Agreed on diffs. For the justification fields proposal: minimal set = [actor, actor_role, approver, reason_code, ticket_id, free_text_reason, justification_ttl_days, redaction_level]. Need sample export shape.
Maria: Also need to document who viewed/edited the justification (access audit). That shows chain-of-custody for compliance.
Oliver: Edge case: overrides applied by automation (e.g., autoscale policy) — actor could be a service principal. We should allow actor_type = human|service and store linked artifact (runbook/ticket).
Sara: Retention: compliance wants 7 years for certain customers. Add export parameters: date_range, include_snapshots (bool), redaction_mode (none/partial/full), signature=true.
Kevin: POC idea: stream NDJSON where each line is one change_event with these top-level fields and a base64 HMAC in header. Example line fields: id, ts, actor, approver, reason_code, ticket, diff_summary, blob_url, redaction_level, signature.
Pranav: Example CSV header we could hand auditors (quick mock):
```
change_id,changed_at,actor,actor_type,approver,reason_code,ticket_id,diff_summary,blob_url,redaction_level,free_text
```
Maria: For PII redaction let's support masking by policy eg `mask(email)` and provide reversible masking only to security teams (requires KMS unwrap).
Oliver: Implementation plan: A) extend change_event schema (optional fields), B) migrate by backfilling recent 2 years for audit customers, C) export endpoint /audit/changes/export supports streaming NDJSON and signed CSV.
Sara: UX: in Console when someone edits a routing/quota policy show a small required justification form with dropdown reason + optional ticket link + checkbox for sensitive data. Also surface an immutable reference id for each justification.
Kevin: Ops: need throttling on export endpoints and a job to generate signed bundles for large ranges. Avoid synchronous generation for >100k events.
Pranav: Next steps: I'll put a brief spec in the eng-platform RFC doc, include sample payloads and the HMAC header format. Action items: Maria/backfill plan, Oliver/schema change PR, Sara/console UI mock, Kevin/export perf design.
Maria: Ack, will draft backfill constraints and PII redaction matrix.
Oliver: I'll start a schema PR and include actor_type handling.
Sara: I'll mock the justification modal and copy for auditors.
Pranav: Thanks — tag me when you have PRs, I'll coordinate with compliance. :+1:
